'''Jymbud''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], one of the many, working for [[Damarind Corporation]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Order]]. He accepted a job as a the captain of [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gem]] fishing station in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the station was attacked by a pack of [[Floater (creature)|floaters]], which killed everyone inside the station, including Jymbud.
